name: test-coverage-pipeline
description: Analyze test gaps, gate on build, write tests in parallel, validate, and loop with an independent reviewer until approved.

steps.prompt: Analyze the Domain project for missing unit tests. Scope: {{scope}}. Write the gap report to .kiro/analysis/test-gaps.md. Finish with send_message severity success once the report is written.

Run `dotnet build BobsBookstore.sln`. If it fails, fix only compile errors and rebuild. Do not change behavior and do not write tests. Finish with send_message severity success when the build is green, or severity error with the build output if you cannot fix it.

branches.prompt: Read the gap report at {{artifacts.gaps}}. You own ONLY the batches whose batch number modulo 3 equals 1 (writer-1). For each batch you own, create or update its test file. If .kiro/workflow-output/review.md exists, first fix the issues it lists for your files. Do not touch files owned by other writers. Skip validation - the workflow validates at the end.

Read the gap report at {{artifacts.gaps}}. You own ONLY the batches whose batch number modulo 3 equals 2 (writer-2). For each batch you own, create or update its test file. If .kiro/workflow-output/review.md exists, first fix the issues it lists for your files. Do not touch files owned by other writers. Skip validation - the workflow validates at the end.

Read the gap report at {{artifacts.gaps}}. You own ONLY the batches whose batch number modulo 3 equals 0 (writer-3). For each batch you own, create or update its test file. If .kiro/workflow-output/review.md exists, first fix the issues it lists for your files. Do not touch files owned by other writers. Skip validation - the workflow validates at the end.

steps.prompt: Run `dotnet test BobsBookstore.sln`. If tests fail, fix the TEST code only - never production code - and rerun. Write a short summary (tests added, passed, failed, and any failures) to .kiro/workflow-output/test-results.md.

Review the new and changed unit tests. Gap report: {{artifacts.gaps}}. Test results: {{artifacts.results}}. Write .kiro/workflow-output/review.md and .kiro/workflow-output/review.json as your instructions describe.

Do not edit files. Using {{artifacts.gaps}}, {{artifacts.results}} and .kiro/workflow-output/review.md, report: batches covered, tests added, pass/fail, review verdict, and how many review iterations it took.
